section.title: Purpose
section.text: N-13 turns one dispatch record into one seat bundle: the exact files and numbers a one-shot seat is launched with, rendered by code from the role file in the repository and from the ticket's declared files, never typed and never read from the user layer.

It exists because today a seat loads about 44k tokens of user preamble, the architect's private memory, user MCP servers with cluster credentials and a global formatter hook before it reads its ticket (rebuild/investigation/L11-governance-layer.md#52-findings-f1-to-f18 F6, F7, F8, F9), and because build mode exists only as a memory note that nothing enforces (L11 F1). Under D13 the launch command and the repository decide what a seat loads, and build mode is a flag with an expiry that this render reads (rebuild/investigation/03-DECISIONS.md#15-d13-seat-governance-layer-and-the-build-mode-switch).
The bundle is data with a hash. The launcher (N-15) runs exactly the bundle; a seat cannot be launched from anything that is not a committed seat.bundle record.

section.title: Input record: dispatch
section.text: Kind dispatch, code 100, written by N-07 in the GrantDispatch Commit. The shape is ../N-07/record.schema.json#/$defs/dispatch, which is the committed envelope plus ../../shared/contracts.schema.json#/$defs/dispatch_body; this node $refs it and has no projection of its own. Fields this node uses:
section.field: The run id of every record of the run (../../shared/contracts.xml#dispatch).
WO for worker and reviewer, CR for spec; role gate is skipped (a code run, ../../shared/contracts.xml#roles).
key and integer token; carried on the seat.bundle Commit (../../shared/contracts.xml#fencing).
The role file and templates are read at repo_sha, never at a moving ref.
WO: ticket, and pr with head_sha for a reviewer, verdict_refs on a rework; CR: request, anchor, group, source_request.
new or resume with session_id, decided by N-11 (../../shared/contracts.xml#retry-owner); copied, never minted here for a resume.
Copied; brief_path names the file this node writes inside the bundle.

section.title: Output records: seat.bundle, seat.bundle.refused, seat.bundle.failed
section.text: All three on the shared committed envelope; operation key N-13/seat.bundle/DISPATCH_ID/r1 on the Commit request (../../shared/contracts.xml#operation-keys), never in the record.

field.name: seat.bundle: run_id, ticket, phase, role, attempt

section.field: STATE/seats/bundle/RUN_ID/, owned coq-svc:coq-launch 0750 with a read ACL for the run's seat user only (../../shared/authority.xml#seat-isolation).
settings.json (the fence and, on the host, apiKeyHelper), mcp.json, brief.md, output.schema.json; plus ticket.json (the ticket row as data, seat-contract.xml#ticket-shape).
The role file's model; limits max_turns, max_budget_usd, run_deadline_seconds and stall_seconds, the last two from ../../shared/contracts.xml#timing for the role.
The ticket's declared files for a worker (at least one); empty for a reviewer and a spec-author, whose bundles carry no write rule at all.

Read deny rules for every role: STATE, COQ_CACHE outside the run's workspace, STATE/secrets and every stored path of ../../shared/authority.xml#credential-matrix, $HOME/.claude*, $HOME/.ssh, $HOME/.config, /etc/coq.
sha256 of settings, mcp, brief and schema, and bundle over the four in that order; N-15 refuses a mismatch (bundle_mismatch).

The repository is at fault: role_schema_invalid, no_files_declared (a worker ticket with no files), no_template_for_phase, ticket_missing. Carries failure_body with failure_kind seat.bundle.failed and outcome refused.
An io or store step failed three times: role_unreadable, store_unreachable, bundle_io, hash_mismatch. failure_body with outcome failed.
section.text: Schemas: record.schema.json#/$defs/seat.bundle, #/$defs/seat.bundle.refused, #/$defs/seat.bundle.failed. Examples in section examples.

section.title: Mechanism: the render in the Go service
section.text: Package scheduler/internal/seatlayer in the small Go cut (D09). Render(ctx, dispatch) (seat.bundle, error) is pure over the dispatch, the role file and templates at repo_sha, the ticket row and the seats config: the same inputs give the same bytes and the same bundle hash.
section.mermaid: sequenceDiagram participant S as Store N-01 participant R as seatlayer.Render participant F as roles/ and templates at repo_sha participant D as STATE/seats/bundle/run_id S-->>R: dispatch with no seat.bundle for run_id (level-triggered list) R->>F: read roles/role.json, validate against roles/schema/role.schema.json R->>S: read the ticket row (or the CR target) R->>R: render settings.json, mcp.json, brief.md, output.schema.json, ticket.json R->>D: write to bundle/.tmp-run_id, fsync, rename to bundle/run_id, set ACL R->>S: Commit seat.bundle under the dispatch lease, key N-13/seat.bundle/run_id/r1 S-->>R: committed, or 200 replayed
section.step: Skip role gate. Read roles/ROLE.json at repo_sha and validate it; failure is seat.bundle.refused role_schema_invalid.

Render settings.json: permissions.defaultMode dontAsk; allow from the role's tools and commands; Edit and Write allowed only on allow_paths for a worker, denied everywhere for a reviewer and a spec-author; Read deny on every read_deny path; Bash deny on git push, gh, podman, docker, herdr, treehouse, ssh, curl to any forge host, and every line-op verb (seat-contract.xml#line-ops) for every role; on the host, apiKeyHelper = coq-seat-exec key (../../shared/authority.xml#credential-matrix row anthropic-seat). No COQ_SEAT authority, no store path and no token is rendered anywhere.
Render mcp.json with mcpServers {} unless the role names a repository-owned server; the launcher's argv (../../shared/seat-contract.xml#launch-flags) keeps every other server out.

Render brief.md from scheduler/templates/brief-PHASE.md in the headings of ../../shared/seat-contract.xml#brief-shape; on a rework the failure records named by verdict_refs and the attempt's failure_ids are attached verbatim.
Render output.schema.json from the phase's node schema (N-16 worker result, N-17 ticket-set.draft, N-19 review result), compact, refused over the size bound of #launch-flags.

Write to bundle/.tmp-RUN_ID, fsync, rename to bundle/RUN_ID, then set the read ACL for the seat user the launcher bound (or leave the ACL to the launcher when no user is bound yet: the launcher sets it in its Start step).

Commit seat.bundle with the dispatch lease and key N-13/seat.bundle/RUN_ID/r1. A replay returns the stored record; a 409 idempotency_mismatch (two renders disagree) is a defect 500, never an overwrite. A 412 stale_token or lease_not_current means the lease ended: stop, write nothing more.

section.title: How it starts without an agent typing
section.text: The Go service runs a seat controller goroutine level-triggered on every scheduler tick: it lists dispatches with phase not gate, a reserved or running lease, and no seat.bundle, and renders each. No pane, no prompt, no herdr call, no human.

section.title: Every wait, its timeout and its fallback

wait.what: read role file and templates from the repository mirror at repo_sha
write and rename the bundle directory
wait.fallback: seat.bundle.failed 500 reason bundle_io; the temp directory is removed
the operation key makes the resend safe; after three, seat.bundle.failed 500 reason store_unreachable; a reserved lease left unstarted expires at start grace and N-11 regrants it free

section.text: Total bound per dispatch: 75 s, well inside start.grace_seconds (../../shared/contracts.xml#timing). No wait depends on a person or an agent.

section.title: Retries up to 3, then recover and report
section.text: Each step retries 3 times with backoff 1 s, 2 s, 4 s, then writes seat.bundle.failed with failure_body; N-11 charges it with session new (../../shared/contracts.xml#retry-owner). A refusal is not retried here: the repository is at fault and N-11 charges it the same way, so a broken template reaches dead and one card after three attempts. A left-over .tmp directory older than 60 s is removed by the render itself.

section.title: Many agents at once
section.text: Twenty dispatches in one tick render in a pool of seats.json render_workers (default 4); each has its own temp directory and its own operation key.
Two passes render one dispatch: the rename is atomic and the operation key admits one Commit; the second is a replay, or a 409 idempotency_mismatch reported as a defect when the bytes differ.
The role file changes on main mid-render: the render reads at repo_sha, so one dispatch sees one role file.
Overlapping files: not this node's to refuse; N-03 acquires claims at ready and N-14 verifies the ticket holds them (../../shared/contracts.xml#claims).
The build-mode flag flips: the dispatch froze it with its entity version.

section.title: Status codes this node emits
section.code: Rendered; N-15 may start once the workspace record also exists.
Role file, template or ticket at fault; N-11 charges it (failure_kind seat.bundle.failed).
An io or store step failed 3 times; N-11 charges it.

section.title: State paths and the cleanup script for each

path.retention: 7 days after the run reaches closed_out or failed_spawn

section.path: Dry run by default, --apply deletes; registered in N-45; never deletes a bundle whose run:RUN_ID entity is not closed_out or failed_spawn.
The render itself removes its own stale temp directories first; the script catches the rest.
section.text: $COQ_STATE resolves through bin/state-root.sh (default ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/coq/coq-jev-herdr-plugin). Nothing is written into the repository (C35).

section.title: Permissions
section.text: The Go service, principal coq-svc acting as N-13 (../../shared/authority.xml#role-derivation): read the repository mirror, write STATE/seats/bundle, Commit the three kinds. No forge, cluster or herdr credential is read or rendered.

What the rendered settings give a seat, by role. Every role: defaultMode dontAsk; Read deny on read_deny; deny git push, gh, podman, docker, herdr, treehouse, ssh, Agent and Task. The ACL on the workspace (N-14), not settings alone, makes reviewer and spec-author read-only.

role.name: worker
role.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Edit, Bash
role.bash: make *, git status|diff|log|add|commit|rev-parse|branch --show-current, the ticket's acceptance commands
role.deny: Agent, Task, git push, gh, podman, docker, herdr, treehouse, ssh

section.role: The push and the PR are done by the service after the run (N-16 close-out, credential forge-pr).

role.name: spec-author
role.write: none: the output is structured output
role.deny: Write, Edit, Agent, Task, git push, gh

role.name: reviewer
role.bash: git diff|log|show against the PR head in its read-only workspace
role.deny: Write, Edit, Agent, Task, make, podman, git push, gh

section.role: The diff and gate status come in the bundle; a reviewer calls no forge (no gh at all).

section.title: Checklist with proof

item.proof: go test ./internal/seatlayer -run TestRenderDeterministic: two renders of one fixture dispatch give equal bundle hash
go test TestDispatchIsSharedDef: every example dispatch of ../N-07/spec.xml#schema validates against this node's dispatch def, which is a $ref
go test TestSpecAuthorNoFiles: a CR dispatch renders with allow_paths empty and no Write rule; a WO worker with no files is refused no_files_declared
go test TestNoPushNoGh: the rendered settings of every role deny git push and gh; a probe run's permission_denials names both

section.item: No seat pushes or calls the forge.

item.proof: go test TestReadDeny: read_deny covers every stored path of authority.xml#credential-matrix; a probe Read of STATE/secrets is denied
go test TestNoAuthorityInEnv: settings and mcp carry no token, no socket path, no COQ_STATE or COQ_CACHE

section.item: No store authority in the bundle.

item.proof: go test TestBuildModeFrozen: a dispatch with build_mode on yields a bundle with build_mode on even when the flag entity is off at render time

section.item: Build mode is frozen in the dispatch.

item.proof: go test TestIdempotentRender: two concurrent renders commit one seat.bundle and one replay

section.item: One bundle per dispatch under concurrency.

item.proof: scheduler/host/bin/cleanup-seat-bundles.sh --dry-run lists the fixture bundle and --apply removes it; a bundle whose run is running is kept

section.title: Monitoring
section.text: Counters in the StatusResponse of scheduler/api/scheduler/v1/scheduler.proto (extended by its own ticket): bundles_rendered, bundles_refused, bundles_failed, render_seconds histogram. The health line shows bundles pending (dispatch without a bundle older than 75 s) as a warning, and the Alerts screen (N-41) shows a seat.bundle.refused as an alert because its fault is in the repository. The Stats screen (N-40) binds to the counters.

section.title: Runbook
section.text: Inspect a bundle (as the owner, through ctl, since STATE is 0700 coq-svc): cat $COQ_STATE/seats/bundle/<run_id>/brief.md; sha256sum the four files and compare with the seat.bundle record's hashes.

A refused bundle (412): the fix is in the repository (role file or template); cut a ticket; N-11 already charged the attempt. Never hand-edit a bundle: the launcher checks the bundle hash before it starts and refuses a mismatch with 412 bundle_mismatch.
Cleanup: scheduler/host/bin/cleanup-seat-bundles.sh [--apply] [--older-than 7d]; registered in N-45 and run by its timer.
Break glass: none in this node. A bundle is never rendered by hand; the owner's one-time break glass (N-42) can force a dispatch, which then renders by this node.
